summary: Frontend test of the vehicle-history popup on /portaal/werkorders/nieuw (desktop 1920 + mobile 390). Seeded TESTH1 (2 open orders, one with a comment) and TESTH0 (0 orders) through the API without owner_email. All requested flows pass. Typing a kenteken with or without dashes or in lowercase opens vehicle-history-dialog, which shows the plate, merk/model, owner, last km, history-order-1/2 with title, date, km, monteur and status badge, history-dialog-timeline (events plus comments) and an amber history-open-orders-warning. Choosing a vehicle in existing-vehicle-select opens the popup. history-dialog-continue and Escape both close it. Typing again (append a character, then backspace) does not reopen it. open-history-button reopens it. TESTH0 and a new plate (ZZ999Q) show no popup, both when typed and when selected. ?kenteken=TESTH1 shows the popup and ?kenteken=TESTH0 does not. The 'Nieuwe order' link in folder /portaal/voertuigen/TESTH1 leads to the popup. Creating the workorder after closing the popup works (WO-00015, 'order 3 van deze auto'). On mobile the popup fits inside the 390px viewport, can be scrolled (scrollHeight 957 > clientHeight 741) and the page does not scroll sideways (docW 390). No page errors.

design_issues.screen: New workorder - typing a known kenteken
issues: Typing the kenteken of an existing vehicle (instead of choosing it from the dropdown) opens the popup, but the merk/model/owner fields stay empty. The form only prefills on dropdown pick or on ?kenteken= first load. Data is not lost: upsert_vehicle ignores empty fields, so the saved vehicle keeps its values. The user still sees an empty form. Consider prefilling empty fields when `existing` changes (low priority).
The dialog runs almost edge to edge (about 1.4px side margin). A small horizontal margin would look cleaner (cosmetic).

action_items: Optional: prefill empty vehicle fields from the existing vehicle when a known kenteken is typed (VehicleSection.jsx effect on existing?.kenteken).
critical_code_review_comments: VehicleSection: shownFor stores only the last kenteken. A->B->A would show A's popup again. In testing, TESTH1 -> TESTH0 -> ZZ999Q -> TESTH1 did not reopen, because TESTH0 has 0 orders and ZZ999Q is not a known vehicle, so neither replaced the stored kenteken. Acceptable, but not strictly 'once per kenteken'.
If one plate is the prefix of another known plate (e.g. AB12 and AB123), the popup opens mid-typing for the shorter plate and takes the focus. Edge case.
VehicleHistoryDialog: the 'Hier hebben we al aan gewerkt.' title also shows while loading and on errors. Fine.
The vehicle list is fetched only once on mount, so order_count may be stale if another user creates an order in the meantime. Minor.
seed_data_creation: TESTH1 (WO-00013 Gepland, WO-00014 In behandeling, plus WO-00015 created through the UI) and TESTH0 created, then all removed. Removed all TEST vehicles/workorders and vehicle:TEST* counters. Workorder counter set back to its pre-test value of 12. S597PJ was not touched. No emails were sent (no owner_email).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use `python /app/backend/tests/seed_ui_iter6.py seed` to seed the history popup data and `... clean [workorder_seq]` to remove it. Check the workorder counter value before seeding and pass it to clean. Popup testids: vehicle-history-dialog, history-order-{volgnummer}, history-dialog-timeline, history-open-orders-warning, history-dialog-continue, open-history-button, existing-vehicle-note.
